_readme.what: Playtest feedback from situations.html: one verdict and note a row -- an eyes row (js/eyes.js: built, not yet seen) or a story situation (?at=<id>, js/situations.js).
_readme.fold_back: Fold every eyes row noted here that is still live in js/eyes.js (a folded row is already cut, so nothing folds twice; previous_save and new_since_last_save only hint at what is new -- RULED 10-15); a story situation note folds when its `at` is after the save of the last ear file folded. An eyes row noted at all is SEEN: a `seen` line in PATCHLOG.md with the note verbatim, and the row cut from js/eyes.js whatever the verdict (a fix that wants another look writes a fresh row). Broken and unclear become the fix list (in the lane its pt names); too hard / too easy are tuning; notes are the tester's words, verbatim.

items.note:
We'll want to remove 'Party' and 'Play Ladder' from the DM side of things
Remove 'Play DM Ladder' from the Front page
Usefuls is a less functional version of DOORS

Got that list of fights, and I can click on a fight and leave a note - but it wants me to save a file there and a save on the previous page with all the fights that saves all the fights and all the notes with them would be better - how is different from ladder 'r' record save?

We have 'humanoids' in the DM monster store in a fashion that makes me think we should pull villains into a new store and allow 'make' from there as well as going through the existing roster and being able to mark as villain or villain only to add to villain store and remove from 'campaign' available party members

There are two pocket DM experiences, player and DM. A DM will want to save multiple ladders (modules?) 
We'll need a 'locations' store that works like the monster store by tileset (i.e. underground, urban, outdoors - probably matching world tile) sorted by map size. Maps chosen/bought here show up on the ladder building screen (instead of all available maps). DM flag when he adds each map if he allows short rest, long rest, market visit between runs of his module(ladder). 

First page (currently when DM clicks 'campaign') should be the DMs units and maps, with load module or build module - or clicking a button near their units and maps where they can buy and add more to their campaign without starting to build a module. 

Campaign saves are DMs units, maps, and roster 
Player saves are current party and pack

The FOES page on the player side becomes the camp, where they can open the standard 'm' menu 
The pick from there, single fight, random ladder or play module (load module to change greyed out play module when none loaded or to change loaded module). For ladder and module play, long rest and daily spells/pre-cast (aid, mage armor) then go to fight. For single fight, map and CR setting, then long rest spell selection.
